name: La Peña (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a green square at the centre bearing a yellow saltire, surrounded by eight yellow crosses of Saint Andrew, with the crowned municipal arms of La Peña at the centre (a rock on green and a sheaf on red).
history: The arms and flag of La Peña were approved on 14 March 2016, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 5 July 2016; the flag is square, of proportions 1:1, green with a yellow saltire and the arms at the centre.

features.role: eight small saltires around the square
